instruction: Candid cinematic full shot of a cozy bedroom. On the left, the barefoot elderly woman with glasses (R2) in a white shirt and light trousers extends her arms forward while dancing. On the right, the elderly bald man (R1) in a striped shirt and khaki pants stands with his back to the camera, facing her. They dance on a dark patterned rug in front of a bed and curtains. Warm, soft indoor lighting fills the room.
